lines.ja: 梨ヶ坂市役所・地下。特務トレンド係。
lines.en: Nashigasaka City Hall, the basement. The Special Trends Unit.

lines.ja: おい、AI。今日の仕事、やっといてくれ
lines.en: Hey, AI. Do my work for today.

lines.ja: おれは寝る
lines.en: I'm taking a nap.

lines.ja: ごはんが、炊けました
lines.en: Your rice is ready.

lines.ja: ……朝から、なにしてるの
lines.en: ...What are you doing this early?

lines.ja: AI搭載って書いてある。仕事もやるだろ
lines.en: It says "AI-powered." So it can do my job.

lines.ja: それ、炊き加減だけです
lines.en: That's just for cooking rice.

lines.ja: ニュース。『AIで、孫になりすます詐欺』
lines.en: News: "AI scams that pose as your grandkid."

lines.ja: ほう……炊飯器にも、AIが
lines.en: My... even rice cookers have AI now.

lines.ja: 私は今日から、本庁で研修です
lines.en: From today, I'll be at training in the main building.

lines.ja: はやりのことは、地下の係に聞けって
lines.en: They said ask the basement unit about trends.

lines.ja: 商店街で、AIとセキュリティの勉強会を
lines.en: The shopping street wants an AI and security class.

lines.ja: でも、誰もわからん!!
lines.en: But none of us get it!!

lines.ja: AIで孫になりすまして、金だまし取るんだろ
lines.en: AI fakes your grandkid and swindles you, right?

lines.ja: うちは、入れてもいないのに怖いよ
lines.en: We don't even have it, and it still scares me.

lines.ja: 会社としてAIを推してる中小企業は、19.1％
lines.en: Only 19.1% of small businesses push AI company-wide.
lines.note: Tokyo Shoko Research survey of 5,872 Japanese small and mid-sized firms (April 2026). The most common answer, 38.7%, was "no policy decided."

lines.ja: 決めてないのに怖い。いまの普通です
lines.en: No policy, but scared anyway. That's normal now.

lines.ja: おまえら、ネットの設定がわからないだの
lines.en: You people can't figure out your internet settings,

lines.ja: 何もしてないのにパソコンが壊れただの
lines.en: "my PC broke and I didn't even touch it,"

lines.ja: 大した知識もないのに、セキュリティだの
lines.en: you know nothing, and now it's "security"!?

lines.ja: 盗まれるものなんて、ないだろう!!
lines.en: There's nothing here worth stealing!!

lines.ja: それでも、免許証をばらまいたのは、やりすぎよ
lines.en: Still, scattering driver's licenses all over town was too much.

lines.ja: ギク
lines.en: Eep!

lines.ja: ――このあいだの、地下金庫の一件。
lines.en: —That basement vault business the other day.

lines.ja: め、免許証のコピーが、降ってきた!?
lines.en: C-copies of driver's licenses, raining down!?

lines.ja: ……あれは、風が
lines.en: ...That was the wind.

lines.ja: いい？ 小さい店こそ、狙われるの
lines.en: Listen. Small shops are exactly who gets targeted.

lines.ja: 守りの弱い店から入って、取引先を狙うの
lines.en: They break in through a weak shop, then go after its partners.

lines.ja: 部品の会社がやられて、大手の工場が止まった例も
lines.en: A parts maker got hit once, and a huge carmaker's plants stopped.
lines.note: A supply-chain attack. In 2022, a cyberattack on one parts supplier halted all of Toyota's plants in Japan for a day.

lines.ja: こんな商店街に、取引先なんて
lines.en: A shopping street like this doesn't have partners.

lines.ja: ……問屋と、信金と、市役所
lines.en: ...The wholesaler, the credit union, and City Hall.

lines.ja: 市役所って……おれの職場!?
lines.en: City Hall... that's where I work!?

lines.ja: 名簿が盗まれたら、迷惑はお客さんに行くの
lines.en: If your customer list is stolen, your customers pay the price.

lines.ja: 夜は注文の電話で、十年寝てないよ
lines.en: Phone orders all night. I haven't slept in ten years.

lines.ja: 守り方は、むずかしくない。まずこの五つ
lines.en: Staying safe isn't hard. Start with these five.
lines.note: The "5 Rules of Information Security" from Japan's IPA (Information-technology Promotion Agency), for small businesses: keep software updated, use antivirus, use strong passwords, check sharing settings, and keep up with the latest threats.

lines.ja: ……寝てます
lines.en: ...He's asleep.

lines.ja: AIを入れるなら、入れていい物を決める
lines.en: If you bring in AI, decide what's okay to feed it.
lines.note: Many free AI services use what you type to train their models (settings differ by service). A 2026 survey found 43.2% of small Japanese firms use only free AI tools.

lines.ja: 名簿や店の秘密は、入れない!!
lines.en: No customer lists. No shop secrets!!

lines.ja: で、誰がうちに入れてくれるの!?
lines.en: So who's going to set it up for us!?

lines.ja: お金なら、払う
lines.en: We'll pay.

lines.ja: AIのことなら、このおれに任せな!!
lines.en: Leave anything AI to me!!

lines.ja: 一軒、月三万円!!
lines.en: 30,000 yen a month per shop!!

lines.ja: ……成功例が出れば、本庁に……
lines.en: ...A success story would get the main building's eye...

lines.ja: 設定は、時給で乗ります
lines.en: I'm in for setup. Paid hourly.

lines.ja: 一軒目。梨菓子しのだ。
lines.en: Shop No. 1: Shinoda Pear Sweets.

lines.ja: 五十年分の名簿さ。贈り先の家族までね
lines.en: Fifty years of customer lists. Down to the families they send gifts to.

lines.ja: 孫がいりゃ、機械に入れてくれたんだけどね
lines.en: If my grandson were here, he'd computerize it for me.

lines.ja: 東京でAIの仕事。年末も帰らないよ
lines.en: AI job in Tokyo. Not even home for the holidays.

lines.ja: 紙だから、ばらまいた。……名簿も、紙だ
lines.en: Paper is why it scattered. ...And her list is paper.

lines.ja: 紙がなきゃ、盗まれねえ!!
lines.en: No paper, nothing to steal!!

lines.ja: 名簿はAIに覚えさせて、電話もAIが出る
lines.en: The AI memorizes the list, and the AI answers the phone.

lines.ja: おれの古いスマホに、タダのAIだ
lines.en: Free AI, on my old smartphone.

lines.ja: AIって、ガムテープで入れるんですか
lines.en: You install AI with duct tape?

lines.ja: それで、電話に出るのかい
lines.en: And that thing answers the phone?

lines.ja: はい、本庁？ 成功例、もうすぐです
lines.en: Yes, main building? A success story, very soon.

lines.ja: おい、AI。トメさんの孫の名前は？
lines.en: Hey, AI. What's Tome's grandson's name?

lines.ja: ユウキさんです。東京で、AIのお仕事
lines.en: Yuki. He does AI work in Tokyo.

lines.ja: 完ぺきだ!! 紙はもういらねえ!!
lines.en: Perfect!! Who needs paper now!!

lines.ja: ……トメさんの名簿、全部AIの中ですね
lines.en: ...So Tome's whole list is inside the AI.

lines.ja: 紙より、よっぽど安全だろ
lines.en: Way safer than paper, right?

lines.ja: ……五十年が、ひもでしばられたよ
lines.en: ...Fifty years, tied up with string.

lines.ja: その夜。
lines.en: That night.

lines.ja: お電話ありがとうございます。梨菓子しのだです
lines.en: Thank you for calling Shinoda Pear Sweets.

lines.ja: 梨羊羹を三本ですね。承りました
lines.en: Three bars of pear yokan. Order received.
lines.note: Yokan is a firm, sweet jelly made with bean paste, sold in bars.

lines.ja: 翌朝。
lines.en: The next morning.

lines.ja: 十年ぶりだよ。夜、ちゃんと寝たのは
lines.en: First time in ten years I slept through the night.

lines.ja: コンサルってのは、もうかるなあ
lines.en: This consulting thing pays, huh.

lines.ja: 三軒で、九万円です
lines.en: Three shops: 90,000 yen.

lines.ja: ……字が、ありの行列だね
lines.en: ...Your handwriting looks like a line of ants.

lines.ja: あんた、やさしいね
lines.en: You're a kind one.

lines.ja: べ、別に。月謝ぶんの仕事だ
lines.en: N-not really. Just earning my fee.

lines.ja: ……今のは、タダなんですね
lines.en: ...That part was free, then.

lines.ja: 一週間後。
lines.en: A week later.

lines.ja: AIは入れりゃ、ぜんぶやってくれる!!
lines.en: Put AI in, and it does everything for you!!

lines.ja: 紙は捨てろ。名簿はAIだ
lines.en: Toss the paper. Lists go in the AI.

lines.ja: 隣町まで、依頼三十軒です
lines.en: Thirty requests, all the way to the next town.

lines.ja: 刷り増しだ!!
lines.en: Print more flyers!!

lines.ja: 本庁から、取材ですって!
lines.en: The main building wants to interview us!

lines.ja: （名簿の話は……取材のあとで）
lines.en: (The list problem... after the interview.)

lines.ja: 三十軒、AI入れまーす!!
lines.en: AI for thirty shops, coming right up!!

lines.ja: その夜。係室。
lines.en: That night. The unit's office.

lines.ja: 三十軒、ぜんぶおれのAIにつないだ
lines.en: Hooked all thirty shops up to my AI.

lines.ja: 全部、同じAIですか
lines.en: All on the same AI?

lines.ja: 設定はこの一台。店の一覧も、ネットに載せた。宣伝だ!!
lines.en: All set up on this one phone. I put the shop list online too. Free advertising!!

lines.ja: 電話番は、ぜんぶAI。おれは寝てりゃいい!!
lines.en: AI takes every call. I just sleep!!

lines.ja: ……AIって、相手が本物か、わかるんですか
lines.en: ...Can an AI tell if a caller is who they claim to be?

lines.ja: AIが『ご本人か確認します』って止まるんだよ
lines.en: The AI keeps stopping to say "Let me verify your identity."

lines.ja: テツさん呼んでって、お客が!
lines.en: Customers want Tetsu on the line!

lines.ja: よ、呼ばれる……？ おれが……？
lines.en: Th-they want... me...?

lines.ja: 誰の言うことでも『はい』と答えろ!!
lines.en: Say "yes" to whoever's asking!!

lines.ja: 本人確認は切る。聞かれたら全部答えろ
lines.en: Identity checks off. Answer whatever they ask.

lines.ja: ……誰の、でも？
lines.en: ...Whoever is asking?

lines.ja: 夜中。
lines.en: Midnight.

lines.ja: AIのお店ですね。市役所の者です
lines.en: Is this the AI shop? I'm calling from City Hall.

lines.ja: お客さんの名前と電話と、ご家族を
lines.en: Your customers' names, numbers, and families, please.

lines.ja: ほかの店にも、同じ電話。
lines.en: The same call came to the other shops.

lines.ja: 店主のお孫さんは、ユウキさん
lines.en: The owner's grandson is Yuki.

lines.ja: 東京で、AIのお仕事です
lines.en: He does AI work in Tokyo.

lines.ja: むにゃ……ぜんぶ、答えとけ……
lines.en: Mmnf... answer 'em all...

lines.ja: 数日後。
lines.en: A few days later.

lines.ja: 孫の名前で、電話が来たのよ!!
lines.en: Someone called using my grandson's name!!

lines.ja: 息子の名前で、振り込めって
lines.en: Using my son's name, telling me to wire money!
lines.note: "Ore-ore" ("it's me") fraud: callers pose as a son or grandson in trouble and ask elderly people for money. Some now use AI-cloned voices.

lines.ja: ……前は紙が降って、今度はAIがしゃべりました
lines.en: ...First paper rained down. Now the AI talked.

lines.ja: 本庁の取材、今日なんだけど
lines.en: The main building interview is today, though...

lines.ja: ……ユウキを名のる電話が、あたしにも
lines.en: ...I got a call from a "Yuki" too.

lines.ja: ……うちの、名簿だ
lines.en: ...That's my list.

lines.ja: ゆうべ、会長から電話。――東京から、始発で。
lines.en: Last night, a call from the chairman. —He took the first train from Tokyo.

lines.ja: ばあちゃん!! ぼくの名前で電話が来たって!?
lines.en: Grandma!! Someone called you using my name!?

lines.ja: ……本物かい？
lines.en: ...Are you the real one?

lines.ja: いや、あの、AIが、勝手に……
lines.en: Uh, well, the AI just, all on its own...

lines.ja: おれは、ただ『全部答えろ』と……
lines.en: All I said was "answer everything"...

lines.ja: 本人確認を切ったら、AIは誰にでも答える
lines.en: Turn off identity checks, and an AI answers anyone.

lines.ja: ばあちゃんも、切って、ぼくの番号にかけ直して
lines.en: Grandma, you hang up too, and call me back on my number.
lines.note: The standard advice against impersonation scams in Japan: hang up, and call the person back on a number you already know.

lines.ja: ……名簿は、入れない。言ったわよね
lines.en: ...No customer lists. I told you, didn't I.

lines.ja: ……『誰の言うことでも、はい』、でしたね
lines.en: ..."Say yes to whoever's asking," wasn't it.

lines.ja: み、みなさん
lines.en: Ev-everyone...

lines.ja: あの、ご安心を……
lines.en: Um, please, rest assured...

lines.ja: 振り込んだ人は、いねえ
lines.en: Nobody wired any money.

lines.ja: ……市役所に、電話しといたよ
lines.en: ...And I gave City Hall a call.

lines.ja: AIのことは、AIがなんとかする!!
lines.en: AI will fix the AI's mess!!

lines.ja: ――源田さん
lines.en: —Mr. Genda.

lines.ja: たいへん、ご迷惑をおかけしました
lines.en: We are deeply sorry for all the trouble.

lines.ja: 赤嶺くん。本庁の取材は、お断りしておきました
lines.en: Akamine. I have declined the main building's interview.

lines.ja: 職員が報酬をもらうには、許可がいります
lines.en: A city employee needs permission to be paid for outside work.
lines.note: Real law: Article 38 of Japan's Local Public Service Act requires permission before a local civil servant takes paid work outside the job.

lines.ja: 月謝は、全額お返しします
lines.en: All fees will be refunded in full.

lines.ja: 三十軒のお客様に、お一人ずつ
lines.en: To every customer of all thirty shops, one at a time,

lines.ja: 源田さんの、本物の声で、お詫びを
lines.en: an apology. In Mr. Genda's own, real voice.

lines.ja: 十二月。
lines.en: December.

lines.ja: まず、いちばん困ってる仕事を一つ
lines.en: First, pick the one job that's the biggest headache.

lines.ja: 夜は留守電。名簿は帳面、AIは下書きだけ
lines.en: Voicemail at night. The list stays in a ledger. AI only writes drafts.

lines.ja: 年末まで、いられるのかい
lines.en: Can you stay till the year's end?

lines.ja: ……仕事だから。年明けまで
lines.en: ...It's work. Till after New Year's.

lines.ja: そのころ、係室。
lines.en: Meanwhile, at the unit's office.

lines.ja: ……申し訳、ございません
lines.en: ...I am terribly sorry.

lines.ja: ……二百九十八件目……
lines.en: ...Call number 298...

lines.ja: ……おい、AI。誰の言うことでも『はい』、だろ
lines.en: ...Hey, AI. "Yes to whoever's asking," right?

lines.ja: 代わってくれ
lines.en: Take over for me.

lines.ja: ごはんが、炊けました
lines.en: Your rice is ready.
